batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c MD Choudhary b Akash Singh

batting.name: RD Gaikwad
batting.dismissal: c N Pooran b Akash Singh

batting.name: Urvil Patel
batting.dismissal: c MR Marsh b Akash Singh

batting.name: Kartik Sharma
batting.dismissal: c AK Markram b Shahbaz Ahmed

balls.text: half-tracker, and tonked into next week! Dube finishes with a flourish, and CSK end up with 187! Sits up outside off and Dube picks it really early. He gets into position and smokes it over deep mid wicket. Clean strike to end the innings, and CSK will be chuffed with this score now!
watch out, bowler because a projectile is coming back at you! In the slot outside off. Dube winds up and bludgeons it pat the bowler. Prince had to duck for cover there!
four more! Full and hung up wide outside off. Dube throws the kitchen sink at it and even though the top hand comes off the bat, he manages to slice it over backward point!
Dube climbs into one now! Juicy full toss on leg. Dube picks it early, gets his front foot out of the way and shovels it over deep square leg!

not sure how to describe that! Let's try anyway. Slower bumper on leg. Veer shapes for the upper-cut initially but has to wait three business days for the ball to arrive. Dangles his bat like a periscope and the ball pings off it to clear the keeper, who had run back to his right!
low full toss on middle and leg. Veer clears his front leg and chips it over the bowler's head. Pooran slides to his right, having run around from long on, and saves two
low full toss outside off. Veer throws his hands at it and slices it towards backward point. Good work by Marsh to his left to keep it to one
very full on middle and off. Dube cannot get under it and clinks it to long on
Dube pings the gap, and gets himself going, finally! This is a half-tracker outside off. Lots of time for Dube to line it up and club it between long on and deep mid wicket!
another short ball, just outside leg. Veer seems to swing at it too early and the ball spoons off the leading edge towards deep third, where Akash sprawls to his right and saves three
bashed in short just outside leg. Veer backs away and swipes at it, but only swats away a few flies in the process
cleverly done! Darted in full on middle and off. Veer shuffles across early, gets down low and laps it past short fine leg!
top yorker outside off and Dube cannot get this away. Clinks it off the toe-end and the ball dribbles through to the keeper
good work by Pant! Back of a length outside off. Veer shimmies across and scuffs his scoop. Pant tumbles to his right and gets a strong right hand to it
into the blockhole outside off. Dube jams down out it and slices it towards deep point

shortish again, just outside off. Dube cloths it to the edge of the ring in the mid on region, and Dube huffs and puffs to complete the second. There is a check for a short run but nothing doing on that count
dug in short outside off. Dube gets on top of the bounce but flat-bats it straight to mid off
short and wide outside off. Dube throws the lot at it but only grabs a handful of fresh air
off-pace on a back of a length on the stumps. Veer punches it enough to long on's left and saunters back for a brace
another slower bumper outside leg but this is too short as well. Veer jumps up before opting to let it go. Called a wide on height, unsurprisingly
slower short ball on leg. Dube swivels and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off. Veer waits on this and opens his bat face at the last moment to run it down to deep third
back of a length outside off and this seems to skid through. Veer wafts at it but only swishes at thin air
banged in short on leg and this balloons over the batter's head. Left alone and called a wide
slower ball bowled fuller on the pads. Dube tucks it towards deep square leg
back of a length just outside off. Dube, rooted to his crease, shanks it towards the bowler. Was trying to punch it down the ground

shanked a touch, and Shahbaz has the last laugh! Speared in full on leg, and this keeps on coming with the angle. Kartik cannot quite get under it fully and arrows it flat to Markram at long on. Kartik throws his head back in disappointment, and LSG will breathe a sigh of relief!
fired in very full outside off. Kartik tries to hit it too hard and chunks it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
right in the gap again, and Kartik is taking Shahbaz to the cleaners! Dragged down on the stumps. Kartik rocks back and pounds it between long on and deep mid wicket!
more runs, and Kartik is putting LSG to the sword now! Shortish and drifting into the pads. Kartik uses the angle and helps it past short fine leg!
my word - this has travelled far and long too! Flighted up full on middle and leg. Kartik gets down on one knee and wallops it over deep mid wicket!
hung up on a back of a length outside off. Dube cuts it towards deep cover

this is another incredible shot! And it is incredible because of how simple Kartik makes it look. Short and wide, and he jumps up onto the air to carve it over backward point. One bounce and into the fence!
short and tucking up the batter on leg. Dube hops up onto his toes and fends it behind square

goes straight up, and Brevis bites the dust! Shortish just outside off and this rears up ever so slightly. Gets big on Brevis as he swipes at it and he only gets height on it. No distance at all and Akash, circling under it at short fine leg, makes no mistake. Big, big wicket for LSG, given how Brevis had begun striking the ball!
back of a length outside off. Kartik hangs back and jabs it towards sweeper cover

goodness me - play that on loop! This is a serious shot, and a staggering way to bring up a half-century. Full outside off. Kartik picks the slower ball, plants his front foot and creams it over extra cover. No notes brought out during the celebration but as Pommie Mbangwa says on broadcast, noteworthy nonetheless!
back of a length on middle and off. Kartik shuffles across, trying to scoop it away but fails to lay bat on ball
on the shorter side again. Brevis hops back and drills it past cover point. Deep cover comes around to his left and saves two
back of a length on middle and leg. Kartik stays back and eases it to long on
fired in on a length on the pads. Brevis pokes it to long on's right. Second contemplated again but not persisted with again
pulls the length back on off after seeing the batter advance. Kartik pushes it to long on
shortish on middle and leg. Brevis backs away and cuts it towards deep cover
back of a length on middle and leg. Kartik tips it into the mid wicket region. Seems intent on the second but Brevis says no
back of a length on middle and off. Kartik hangs back and punches it to long on
short ball, and dumped into the stands again! Kartik on the move! The direction is the problem this time. Sliding down leg and Kartik can help it merrily over fine leg!
right out of the screws! Shortish on off and this sits up just the way Kartik wants. He opens up his stance and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
safe, just! Slower bumper outside off. Brevis gets up on his toes and swipes at it. A bit of a miscue and it nearly carries to deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off. Kartik waits for it and knocks it to long on
ouch! Angled in full on the stumps. Brevis drills it back into his partner at the other end and that will not tickle
zipped in very full just outside off. Brevis jams it out to mid off and keeps strike
safe again! Shortish and angling into the hips. Kartik is hustled on the pull again and the ball seems to loop up off the glove beyond Pant
hard length, tucking up the batter as he steps outside leg. Kartik prods it back to the bowler. This was bowled at 147.8kph
banged in much shorter on middle and off. Kartik sways out of the way
shot! Dug in short on middle and off. This is a touch slower (still in the 144kph range, though), and Kartik hares down to flay it past backward point!
back of a length, slanting into middle and leg. Bowled at 150.4kph and Kartik, shaping to pull, is late on the stroke. Pinged on the thigh pad

oh, this is a Dewald Brevis special! Floated up into the slot outside off. Brevis gets down low and clatters it over long on. Does not even look up to see where the ball has gone. Trademark no-look six!
back of a length wide outside off. Kartik reaches out and scuffs it towards deep cover
fired in full on middle and leg. Eased down the ground to long on
fullish outside off. Brevis gets onto the front foot and drives it between deep cover and long off. Has enough time to dash back for two
flighted up very full just outside off. Kartik plants his front foot and drills it to long on
this is a stunning shot! Dragged down a touch outside off. Sits up and the width allows Kartik to free his arms and bulldoze it over extra cover!
another sharp short ball, climbing through outside off. Bowled at 140.3kph and Brevis hops up onto his toes to drop it into the point region
back of a length just outside off. Kartik waits on this before running it down to deep third
back of a length on middle and leg. Gets big on Kartik again and he fends it towards mid wicket. This was bowled at 141.6kph
back of a length just outside off. Kartik stays leg side of the ball and dabs it to backward point
hard length on middle and leg, bowled at 144.2kph. Kartik hops up onto his toes and drops it into the mid wicket region
speared in full on middle and leg. Brevis pushes it down the ground to long on
shortish on the stumps. Kartik goes back and punches it straight to extra cover
bye-bye ball! Marginally short just outside off, and Kartik is all over it like a rash. He rocks back and pummels it over deep mid wicket!
slowed up on a length on leg. Kartik tries to back away but is still cramped for room. Poked to extra cover
back of a length, angling into off. Kartik gets a half stride in and jabs it to extra cover
back of a length on middle and off. Brevis hops back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
flighted up full outside off. Kartik stretches forward and knocks it to long off
full outside off. Kartik gets onto the front foot and pushes it enough to mid off's left to keep strike
back of a length on middle and leg. Brevis tips it to mid wicket and saunters across to the other end
hard length on the stumps. Brevis hangs back and defends
attempted slower short ball but this sneaks harmlessly down leg. Left alone and called a wide
oh, hello! Brevis has arrived! Banged half-way down outside off. Brevis leaps up onto his toes and thunders it over deep point!

swatted straight to deep mid wicket, and the chit makes its third appearance! Banged in short outside off and this sits up, which makes Urvil's eyes light up. Urvil gets decent purchase on the pull but does not muster the elevation or the requisite direction. Straight to Marsh, and Akash is having a field day, as is the chit in his pocket!
back of a length just outside off. Kartik hangs out his bat and chops it towards the keeper. Urvil is alert enough to pinch a single
shot! Slanted in full on middle and leg. Urvil consciously keeps it down by rolling his wrists and clips it past mid wicket!
Mayank tests out the middle of the track again, outside off. Urvil ducks under it and the umpire calls it a wide on height
back of a length, tailing down leg. Urvil does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide. That was bowled at 147.3kph, for what it is worth

off the glove but safe! Bumper on leg, bowled at 142.1kph. Kartik is hurried on the pull and is lucky that landed enough to the keeper's left. Well, looks like the ball also pinged off the helmet. Concussion check underway.
hard length, honing into middle and off. Kartik stays back and pokes it towards extra cover
shortish on middle and leg. Kartik gets up on his toes, rolls his wrists and helps it down to fine leg
up and over, and Kartik gets his first boundary! Right in the slot outside off and Kartik capitalizes. He goes through the line and pops it over mid off!
back of a length on middle and leg. Kartik gets up on his toes and pats it into the mid wicket
low full toss speared down leg. Kartik does not get anywhere near it and the umpire calls it a wide
on a length just outside off. Urvil has a stab at it in front of his body and chunks it off the inside edge into his body
hard length, pitching just outside off and nipping back in a touch. Kartik hops up onto his toes and dabs it behind point
short and skidding through outside off. Kartik throws his hands at it but only connects with fresh air

whipped straight to deep square leg, and the chit comes out again! Back of a length on the pads, and this is there to be put away. Samson, though, has a half-hearted pop at it. Not enough of a flourish or follow-through either, and Samson could not have picked out Mukul better. Akash points to his head while also showing the chit, and LSG are applying the squeeze now!
back of a length just outside off and this seams away with the angle. Samson wafts at it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
back of a length outside off. Samson rises with the bounce and punches it through cover point. Shahbaz nearly makes a meal of it on the fence but stops the boundary in the end
full toss speared into the pads and Urvil misses out. Looks to help it fine but only manages to chunk it off the toe-end towards the keeper
another sharp short ball on middle and leg. Urvil, trying to help it fine, is late on the pull and the ball whistles past. Wobbles too after passing the stumps but Pant covers it well
miscued but safe! Shortish outside off. Urvil has a hack across the line and splices it just over mid wicket. Off the mark with a brace
back of a length on off. Samson waits for it and drops it into the point region
banged in short outside off and this whizzes through too. Samson swipes at it and seems to get beaten for pace
jaffa! Back of a length in the channel and this shapes away late, despite threatening to angle in. Samson nibbles at it and is beaten
almost a first-ball duck for Urvil! Dug in short just outside off and this climbs through steeply. Urvil has a fend at it and nearly pops it to short third. Just short of the fielder in the end

clothed tamely to mid on, and Akash has something to show for his early toil! Hard length just outside off and this skids through. Gaikwad looks for the pull but is late on the stroke because of the extra pace and bounce. Off the splice and mid on does the rest. Akash brings out a celebratory chit too (although not sure what was on it) and Gaikwad departs early again!
up and over! Fullish outside off and Gaikwad takes full toll. He plants his front foot and lifts it neatly over extra cover. One bounce and into the fence!
back of a length on leg. Samson stays back and tugs it behind square for a single

has Samson nicked it? Pant and Akash think so, and LSG review rather promptly! Sharp bumper on leg and this zips through. Samson shapes for the pull and but is rushed on the stroke. LSG think the ball has grazed the glove or the top edge. Samson seems confident that he has not nicked it. Absolutely nothing on UltraEdge, so there will be no caught-behind. The third umpire initially asks for graphics to check the wide but that does not materialize. Samson stays!
full ball on the pads. Gaikwad gets onto the front foot and helps it behind square for a couple of runs
oh! Back of a length outside off and this leaves the batter late. Samson goes fishing at it without any footwork and is beaten on the outside
banged in short outside off and this sails through. Samson thinks about a pull for a moment before bailing out of it
shorter and wider outside off. Samson gets up on his toes and jabs it past cover point. Back for a couple of runs. No exaggerated trigger movement this time
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards deep backward point
fullish and shaping away wide outside off. Samson reaches out for it and slices it towards deep backward point. Samson did his trigger movement to the leg side again, exposing his stumps
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad throws his hands at it and cracks it towards deep backward point
back of a length on middle and off. Samson stays beside the line and plays it back to the bowler
length just outside off. Gaikwad gets a half stride in before patting it towards deep backward point
back of a length on off. Samson stays leg side of the ball and pushes it off the back foot towards deep point
fuller on middle and off, and this shapes in late. Gaikwad comes half forward and pokes it towards mid on
helped on its way! Maybe not entirely in control. Sharp bumper on leg and Gaikwad, rushed on the pull, hooks it off the top edge into the fine leg fence!
dug in short just outside leg. Gaikwad takes a step down the track before dropping it into the on side
shorter outside off. Samson gets up on his toes and scuffs it towards cover point
length ball and this swings well down leg. Pant lunges to his left and gets a glove to it. Saved four there

streaky but Samson will take it! Length ball outside off. Samson looks to force it through the off side again but squirts it off the inside edge past the stumps. Diametrically opposite to where he was aiming!
that has flown to the fence! On a length outside off and moving away. Samson covers it, stays on top of the bounce and scorches it past extra cover!
back of a length just outside off. Same trigger movement (of going back and towards leg stump) before Samson jabs it towards cover point
off the mark now, and in pristine fashion! Fuller on middle and off, and shaping away again. Samson goes back to the leg side and then cracks it past extra cover!
peach to begin! Fullish outside off and this curves away late. Samson goes feeling for it away from his body and is beaten on the outside

four sixes to finish the game, and four daggers to CSK hearts! CSK's playoff charge has been dented, and LSG have run rampant in front of their fans! Misses the yorker again on the shorter side. In the slot on middle and leg, and Pooran slams it over long on. Kamboj concedes 63 in 2.4 overs, and CSK do not know what has hit them tonight. LSG have been full value for their win, and they have blown CSK out of the water tonight!
pumped into the sightscreen, and Pooran has somewhere to be! Slot ball outside off and that is into Pooran's wheelhouse. He goes through the line and thunders it over Kamboj's head!

another high ball, and this goes through Kartik's hands! Fuller on middle and leg. Pooran plants his front foot and launches it to the moon. The ball comes down with snow on it and Kartik, trying to take it near his right shoulder, lets the ball slip through his fingers. Perhaps a little circumspect about where he was standing too but either way, he will be disappointed with the effort!
that has gone an absolute mile! Back of a length on middle and off. Pooran gets his front foot out of the way and clubs it way over the wide long on fence. A 101m six!
Good work by Kartik, charges to the right from deep midwicket and keeps it to two. Pick-up flick off a length, clears the infield and rolls away
Edge? No. 140ks fullish length ball outside off, Choudhary stands still and looks to go hard through cover. Misses
Pulls and misses. Shortish ball on fourth stump, Choudhary's hand-speed is high again, gets no contact though
And M Choudhary brings the equation to under a run a ball. This had a width and enough shortness for the slap over cover. Still an audacious shot as he danced down the pitch
Looks to launch it fine, misses. Pooran crouches and looked to pick it up off a length, gets hit high on the left of the front pad. Goes to square leg
Pitched up outside off, reaches forward and pushes through extra cover
Wide, and cut! Length not an issue. Line was. Pooran waits and gets low. Ball goes fine, between backward point and deep third
Length at the stumps, flicked to midwicket

Almost cut in half, and the inside edge flies to the left of Samson. He dove full length but it was slightly away from his reach. Around a back of length, stump line, Choudhary stayed in the crease and kept bat relatively close to body. He got the perfect edge luckily. 150 up for LSG
Direct hit? No. Cover fielder misses. Was a full ball that was pushed gently to cover's left. Choudhary took a couple of steps and went back, Pooran ran and turned back as Kartik threw.
LBW appeal... only from the bowler. Looked to have landed down leg. Length ball beats the flick and deflects to the off side
Touch wide on a length, 136ks, run down to deep third with a fully open face
Tight single. Midwicket and bowler converge, batters make it. Shortish ball pulled off the bottom of the bat, may have gone off the pad to the leg side
Fuller side of length on off, 140ks, Pooran looked to defend straight. Ball bounces just behind him and bounces over the wickets
Touch back of length outside off, looked to go away again. Pooran misses the cut
Length in the channel, guided to deep third with bat behind pad

Through him this time. "Come on" yells Johnson as Pant sits and walks from the dugout. Not too dissimilar a length than the last ball, a touch shorter if at all. Pace goes up from 133 to 143kph. It looked to have seamed in a bit and Samad went for a flick with a closed face. Left quite a gap that the ball breached, middle stump left flat on the ground
Johnson delivers a slot ball and Samad tonks it over wide long-on. It close to length but still full enough for Samad to step-hit hile standing beside the line
Pooran sees off Noor. He finishes with 0 for 21. Length ball on off, gets square on and defends straight
Pooran too early into the sweep, ball hits high on the front pad and goes to short third. Back of length just outside off, good bounce. Three dots in a row
Shapes to turn it to the leg side. The ball bounces extra and hits the sticker, goes straight
Wide and fullish, chomped off the bottom-half back into the pitch
Stays back and punches it down the ground
Fullish outside off, swept to deep backward square leg
Shortish outside off, pulled to deep square leg

Fingertip run-out at the non-striker's! Marsh not even in the picture. He took a couple of steps forward as Pooran drove the 138ks full ball down the ground. It would've hit the stumps even if Choudhary hadn't touched it. Hit only the little finger. In the end, he didn't change the ball's direction much. No century for Marsh, unfortunate
Whiplash... wicket! Inglis went hard for the cut, may have played it a touch too early. Ends up slicing it to deep point. Offcutter into the pitch outside off.
Pitched right up outside off, driven to deep cover
Pace off not working. Length was right, height was good but it came off the pitch evenly. Marsh muscles a pull through forward square leg
Length at the stumps, helps it over with a flick. Goes to long leg
Fuller side of length just outside off, 94ks, punched to long-off
Skids through, Marsh plays it nicely. Length on middle and leg, flicked off the back foot to long-on
Fullish on middle and leg, flicked softly leg side
Goes for a hard sweep. The length ball just outside fizzes through to beat bat
Length at the stumps, worked off the back foot to long-on
Shortish ball on leg, pulled to deep-backward square
One-handed cover drive sizzles grass. Marsh walked down and may have been done in the air there but went through with the shot. There was width, and he got it into the ground nicely
Drills the full ball to mid-on for a quick single. Looked slow
Reverse sweep beaten. Inglis looked to go aerial and fine. The length ball angled away through fourth stump and got decent bounce to beat bat. Inglis looks up and smiles
Powers the slower ball through midwicket. Inglis getting his torso low to reach the full ball and whipped it with a closed face
Shortish slower ball deceives Inglis. He craned back and looked to upper cut with a bat-swirl, waited but couldn't time it right. Beaten
Missed yorker, Marsh misses out too. Full toss floats well outside off, Marsh gets on one knee and slaps it. Finds cover
flighted up full outside off. Marsh comes forward and eases it to long off to retain strike
back of a length outside off. Inglis takes a step down and turns it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off, bowled from well behind the crease. Marsh knocks it to long on
angled in full on the pads. Inglis glances it to short fine leg
back of a length outside off. Inglis gets down on one knee and hacks at it but ends up jamming it off the inside edge into his body
fired in full on middle and leg. Marsh gets down on one knee and hoicks it towards deep square leg
slower ball on a full length outside off. Marsh waits for it and drives it to long off
hang that in the Louvre! This is just...sumptuous. Fullish on the stumps. Marsh dances down the track, gives himself room and creams it over deep cover!
back of a length on the pads. Inglis tucks it towards deep square leg and keeps things ticking
back of a length on middle and off. Marsh drops it into the off side and picks up another single
CSK continue leaking runs! Shortish on the hips and this is fodder for Marsh. He rolls his wrists slightly and swings it away past short fine leg!
dug in short on leg stump. Inglis hops onto the back foot and pulls it towards deep square leg
fullish on middle and leg. Inglis comes onto the front foot and turns it towards deep mid wicket
fuller on middle and off. Seems like another googly and Marsh nudges it into the off side
goodness gracious me - that has been smoked! Googly dragged down on off. Marsh picks it early and thumps it flat over deep mid wicket!
googly on a length outside leg. Marsh has a swipe at it and misses, with the ball rolling off the pad into the off side
short and wide outside off. Inglis goes back and punches it towards sweeper cover
googly on a back of a length on off. Inglis hangs back and dabs it towards backward point
a bit of a miscue, but this goes all the way too! Shortish and tucking up the batter. Looks like Marsh will be cramped for room but he still manages to muccle it over the long leg fence!
this has been butchered too! And Marsh brings up a fifty off 21 balls! Slower ball and this is crying out to be hit. Sits up on off and Marsh blasts it to deep square leg's left!
Marsh is on a roll now! Back of a length outside off. Marsh stands up tall and demolishes it over mid off. Brilliant batting!
off-pace on a back of a length on off. Inglis gets behind the line and stabs it towards mid wicket
back of a length on the stumps, and this seems to move away with the angle. Inglis backs away again, looking to cut it over the ring but fails to make contact
over the top! Slower ball on a fullish length on middle and off. Inglis backs away and slices it over backward point!
28 off the over, and Marsh has blown this run-chase open! This is another hit-me ball. Full toss sliding down leg and Marsh helps it into the fine leg fence!
phew - what has that hit?! Slot ball just outside off, and Marsh hits it as hard as anyone has hit a ball all season. Kamboj somehow gets his foot in the way, and this will sting

four sixes in the over - and could six sixes actually be on the cards now?! Shortish again and this has become so predictable that Kamboj might have sent Marsh a telegram. Marsh walks down again and wallops it over deep square!
well, make that 102 sixes in the IPL for Marsh! Another half-tracker, and this is begging to be hit on middle and leg. Marsh obliges and dumps it over deep square leg!
pick the bones out of this one too! Shortish outside off and this sits up nicely. Marsh lets the ball arrive before obliterating it over mid wicket!
this is an outrageous shot! Half-tracker on middle and off. Marsh marches down the track, frees his arms and flays it over cover!
full just outside off. Marsh comes half forward and pokes it to mid off. Keeps strike too
serious wheels again! On the shorter side, slanting across the batter outside off. Marsh has a wild whoosh at it and misses. 142.4kph that
back of a length just outside off. Inglis opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third
a little shorter and this breezes through. Inglis has a swipe at it and only connects with the fresh Lucknow air
sharp short ball on middle and off, and this kisses the surface to zip through. Inglis backs away, trying to dab it but is beaten for pace
Inglis takes on Johnson! Length ball outside off. Inglis takes a step across his stumps, picks it up and hoists it over mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Marsh gets up on his toes and taps it towards backward point
back of a length outside off. Marsh gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point
back of a length outside off and this nips back in late. Marsh opts to let it go and is just about vindicated
four more! Dug in short on middle and off. Marsh hares down the track this time and blitzes it through point. That sped away!
back of a length on middle and leg. Inglis stands up tall and hoicks it over mid wicket. Mukesh chases after it and reins it in
through the gap! Back of a length outside off. Inglis covers the swing and threads it between cover point and extra cover!
oh! Back of a length outside off and this nips away with the angle. Marsh goes feeling for it away from his body and gets beaten. This was bowled at more than 143kph too
hard length on middle, and this nips back in. Steep bounce, owing to Johnson's frame, and Marsh seems to cop a blow on the arm
back of a length outside off. Marsh looks to force the issue through the off side and scuffs it to mid off
the length is fine but the line is not on this occasion. Swinging down leg and some more exercise for the umpire
ripper! Length ball on middle and leg, and this curves in devilishly. Inglis is cut in half and Samson, diving to his left, can only parry it to fine leg. Bowled at 141.7kph
spliced up but safe! Hard length on middle and off. Gets big on Inglis as he hacks at it but he gets just enough to clear Noor at mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Inglis reaches out for it and scuffs it into the off side
starts off with a short ball that slides down leg. Inglis looks to pull but misses. Called a wide
Mukesh with a sharp riposte! Much shorter and this kicks up, while also angling in from outside off. Nowhere to go for Inglis and he ends up on the deck as he runs this down to deep third

Inglis starts from where he left off in Chennai! Back of a length, swerving towards off stump. Inglis shimmies across, gets down low and laps it past the keeper. May have been off the thigh pad but the impact was outside the line. May have been high too!
back of a length just outside off. Marsh hangs back and with an open bat face, guides it towards deep backward point
more runs! Back of a length and drifting into the pads again. Marsh gets inside the line and helps it fine past the keeper!
